resources.string: The check contacts the project on GitHub. Family settings, router address and router token are not sent. Download and install checks the file and opens Android confirmation. If installation permission is requested, enable it and return; no second download is needed. App settings and router pairing are preserved. A local test build may have no update with the same signature.
